name: B10-0252/2025 (Renew) – Return of Ukrainian children forcibly transferred and deported by Russia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the return of Ukrainian children forcibly transferred and deported by Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the immediate return of all Ukrainian children taken to Russia or Russian-held areas. It says over 19,000 children have been deported, many forced into adoption, identity changes and military training. It condemns these acts as war crimes that may amount to genocide. It asks Russia to give full information on the children and let international organisations reach them. It wants the children's return to be a condition for any peace talks. This is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing in law. Parliament demands Russia stop the deportations and return all children.
- **Who it affects:** Ukrainian children and families, Russia, Belarus, the European Union and international bodies.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, Commission, United Nations, Red Cross and Ukraine.
